implementation: Playback owns edition/action notices and binding recovery notices. Save failure derives from pending account writes. One status query selects messages for account, book, or edition. No unscoped message getter or UI text comparisons remain.
lifetime: A successful open or Play clears the action notice. A recovery warning remains for its account binding. A save warning remains until the pending account writes succeed. Account replacement clears binding notices. Command failures retain their attempted source and reject obsolete account/source results.
